name: 2472 Pentair FRP Vessel
summary: The Pentair FRP Pressure Vessel 2472 is a heavy-duty fiberglass reinforced plastic (FRP) pressure vessel designed for commercial and industrial water treatment systems.
intro: The Pentair FRP Pressure Vessel 2472 is a heavy-duty fiberglass reinforced plastic (FRP) pressure vessel designed for commercial and industrial water treatment systems. Featuring a 24" diameter × 72" height with top and bottom openings, it is ideal for multimedia filtration, activated carbon filtration, water softening, demineralization, and other high-flow water purification applications. Manufactured from corrosion-resistant FRP, the vessel delivers excellent durability, lightweight handling, and long service life while operating safely at pressures up to 10 Bar (150 psi). It is suitable for use with a wide range of filtration media and is designed to perform reliably in demanding water treatment environments. Pentair FRP vessels are known for their superior strength, chemical resistance, and low maintenance requirements.
